title: Helios Console — Managed Configuration
description: Managed configuration for the Helios Console macOS app. Preference domain MUST equal the app's bundle identifier: com.helios.console. Values set here are FORCED and override the in-app Settings (which appear locked). The app reads a nested structure; keep the object groupings below. SECURITY: managed-preference plists are world-readable on disk — scope the master API Role to the minimum privileges the app needs, and scope this profile to the appropriate machines (in particular, only Admin-role machines should receive a master client that has Cleanup write/delete scopes).

jamfPro.title: Jamf Pro Connection
jamfPro.description: Master API client used for inventory reads (and, on Admin machines with the proper role, Cleanup writes).

serverURL.title: Jamf Pro Server URL
serverURL.description: Full HTTPS base URL of the Jamf Pro instance, no trailing slash. Example: https://yourorg.jamfcloud.com

masterClientID.title: Master API Client ID
masterClientID.description: OAuth client_id of the Jamf API Client used by Helios. Not secret.

masterClientSecret.title: Master API Client Secret
masterClientSecret.description: OAuth client_secret for the master API Client. Delivered via this profile. NOTE: managed-preference plists are readable on disk — scope the API Role tightly and rotate if exposed.

requiredRoleName.title: Required Jamf API Role Name
requiredRoleName.description: Name of the Jamf API Role the master client is expected to hold. Informational / used for diagnostics.

screenShareEnabled.title: Enable Screen Share
screenShareEnabled.description: Enables the in-app Screen Share affordance.

role.title: Operator Role
role.description: Role-based access control. The destructive Cleanup feature (bulk unmanage / move / group / delete of stale device records) is shown ONLY when this is exactly "Admin". Any other value — Support, User, blank, missing, or a typo — hides Cleanup (fail-closed). Scope this profile so only intended admin operators receive role=Admin.

userInterface.title: User Interface
userInterface.description: Branding / UI text shown in the app.

appTitle.title: App Title
appTitle.description: Primary title shown in the app header.

appSubtitle.title: App Subtitle
appSubtitle.description: Secondary title shown in the app header.

supportURL.title: Support URL
supportURL.description: Optional link surfaced for end-user support.

localAdministration.title: Local Administration
localAdministration.description: Local admin account settings used by the app.

username.title: Local Admin Username
username.description: Local administrator account name the app references.

cleanup.title: Cleanup (Stale Device) Settings
cleanup.description: Defaults for the Admin-only Cleanup feature. These are starting values; the stale threshold can be adjusted in-app unless you also lock the field by setting it here.

staleDays.title: Stale Threshold (days)
staleDays.description: Devices with no Jamf Pro check-in for this many days are considered stale.

defaultStaticGroupID.title: Default Static Group ID
defaultStaticGroupID.description: Optional Jamf static computer group ID pre-selected in the 'Add to static group' action picker.

defaultSiteID.title: Default Site ID
defaultSiteID.description: Optional Jamf site ID pre-selected in the 'Move to site' action picker.

jamfProtect.title: Jamf Protect (optional)
jamfProtect.description: Optional Jamf Protect tenant connection for the Cleanup feature's Protect cards and independent Protect-record deletion. The Protect API password may be delivered here (it then locks the in-app field) or left out and entered in the app (Keychain).

enabled.title: Enable Jamf Protect
enabled.description: Turn on the Jamf Protect integration.

url.title: Jamf Protect Tenant URL
url.description: Full HTTPS tenant URL. Example: https://yourorg.protect.jamfcloud.com

password.title: Jamf Protect API Password
password.description: Jamf Protect API password. Optional — if set here it is used and the in-app field locks; if omitted, it is entered in the app and stored in the Keychain. Sensitive: managed-pref plists are world-readable, so scope this profile tightly.

appleBusinessManager.title: Apple Business Manager (optional)
appleBusinessManager.description: Optional ABM API connection (AppleCare lookups via ES256 JWT).

enabled.title: Enable ABM
enabled.description: Turn on the Apple Business Manager integration.

clientID.title: ABM API Client ID
clientID.description: Apple Business Manager API client id.

keyID.title: ABM Key ID
keyID.description: Apple Business Manager private key id.

privateKey.title: ABM Private Key (PEM)
privateKey.description: PEM-encoded ES256 private key for ABM JWT signing. Sensitive — delivered via this profile; scope tightly.
